hook: Your capsule fires rockets right before it lands.
title: Soyuz Fires Rockets Just Before Touchdown
description:
A Soyuz capsule slows under a parachute, then fires small rockets just above the Kazakh steppe. The burst kicks up a cloud of dust and softens the landing.

Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Soyuz
comment_prompt: Would you ride it? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your capsule fires rockets right before it lands.
scenes.headline: ROCKETS AT LANDING

scenes.narration: This is a Soyuz coming home to Kazakhstan.
scenes.headline: SOYUZ RETURNS

scenes.narration: First, a parachute slows the fall.
scenes.headline: PARACHUTE FIRST

scenes.narration: It is still too fast for comfort.
scenes.headline: STILL TOO FAST

scenes.narration: So small rockets fire just above the ground.
scenes.headline: ROCKETS FIRE

scenes.narration: They blast a cloud of dust across the steppe.
scenes.headline: DUST CLOUD

scenes.narration: Your capsule touches down gently, wrapped in dust.
scenes.headline: GENTLE TOUCHDOWN

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: your phone shows what eyes cannot see.
scenes.headline: NEXT: YOUR PHONE
